title: Bench-Scale Liquid-Phase Microaeration and Iron Dosing Comparison for In Situ Biogas Desulfurization and Antibiotic Resistance Management in Mesophilic Anaerobic Digestion

abstract_evidence_excerpt: Microaeration and iron dosing are promising in situ desulfurization methods for anaerobic digestion (AD). Consequently, this study investigated liquid-phase microaeration (60–106 mL air/L reactor /d) and ferric chloride (250–650 mg FeCl 3 /L) dosages in mesophilic AD of sewage sludge operated at a solid residence time of 20 days.
